messages:
amanda: Quick heads-up — starting the tenant billing schema migration prep in 30m. plan: pin api-service to v3.1.2, apply small column add + backfill in waves. quiet window 01:00-03:00 UTC.

matt: ACK. Which table and estimated row count? any long locks expected?

amanda: table invoices_payments, ~12M rows in prod. backfill will be batched, we expect short exclusive lock only for the ALTER (sub-ms) but the backfill uses UPDATE with batch-size 5k.

leila: Re: batching — set BACKFILL_BATCH_ROWS=5000 and BACKFILL_SLEEP_MS=250 in deploy config. That should keep p99 token latency under SLO.

jonas: Suggest pinning read replicas to route read load off primary for the backfill window. If we see >1s lock wait, we pause and route reads.

amanda: Good call. I'll include a traffic-dampen rule in the rollout: 80% reads -> replicas, 20% fallthrough to primary.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @amanda: migration-job v2026-06-15 -> started canary on three workers. Canary backfill sample size 10k rows.

matt: If canary looks good, what's the escalation path? rollback small or full rollback?

amanda: Escalation: 1) Pause backfill (deploy-bot hold), 2) Roll traffic back to normal, 3) If corruption/constraint hit -> rollback to db snapshot from pre-migration and open incident.

paul: Note for runbook — sql snippet to validate null-safety before full apply:
```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM invoices_payments WHERE new_field IS NULL AND status != 'cancelled';
```
Run after every batch.

sre-oncall: I'll watch lock_monitor and pg_stat_activity. If lock_waits spikes > 50ms for 2 consecutive minutes, we hit the holdpoint and pause. ping me in #incidents.

leila: Also adding an automatic fallback: if deploy-bot sees 3 consecutive batch errors it will auto-pause and tag the thread. I'll include the deploy-bot flag `--auto-pause-on-error`.

deploy-bot: canary results: 10k sample completed, 0 constraint violations, avg batch latency 180ms, peak lock_wait 22ms. Marking canary success.

amanda: Rolling to 25% workers now. pushing release note: "billing migration: add invoice_tax_code (backfilled). Pin api-service v3.1.2 for migration window."

matt: Please add in release note: DB snapshot timestamp and revert command.

amanda: done. release note: "snapshot: rds-prod-snap-2026-06-15-0100; revert: rds-restore --from rds-prod-snap-2026-06-15-0100"

jonas: One more: gate long-running queries—if any session runs > 5m during window, auto-kill after notify. save logs to s3://redwood-migration-logs/1769459999/

amanda: Affirmative. proceeding. will post final status once full rollout completes. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout at 25% -> progressing. watch thread for hold instructions.
